title: Featherdale Wildlife Park
description: Get nose-to-nose with wombats, hand-feed kangaroos and spot koalas up close at one of Sydney's best wildlife parks — a guaranteed hit with kids of every age.
longDescription:
Featherdale Wildlife Park in Doonside is one of the best places in Sydney to get up close with Australian animals. With over 1,700 animals across 260 species, it's a hands-on wildlife experience the whole family will love.

Highlights include:
- Hand-feed kangaroos and wallabies
- See koalas, wombats and Tasmanian devils
- Meet reptiles and birds in walk-through aviaries
- Up-close encounters with native Australian wildlife
- Perfect for all ages including toddlers and babies

title: Luna Park Sydney
description: Rides, fairy floss and harbour views — Luna Park is Sydney's most iconic family fun destination right on the water at Milsons Point.
longDescription:
Luna Park Sydney has been delighting families since 1935 and sits in one of the most spectacular locations in the world — right on the harbour at Milsons Point with sweeping views of the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House.

What's on offer:
- Classic rides and thrill rides for all ages
- Toddler and junior rides for little ones
- Carnival games and fairy floss
- Stunning harbour and bridge views
- Special school holiday events and entertainment
- Combine with a ferry ride for extra fun
seoTitle: Luna Park Sydney – Iconic Rides & Harbour Views for the Whole Family

- Visit the duck and goose ponds
- Free playgrounds for different age groups

- Seasonal events including Easter egg hunts and summer concerts
- Horse riding nearby (paid)

title: Sydney Zoo – Western Sydney's Wild Adventure
description: Come face to face with giraffes, gorillas, hippos and hundreds more animals at Sydney Zoo in Bungarribee Park — a brand new world-class zoo in Western Sydney.
longDescription:
Sydney Zoo opened in 2019 in Bungarribee Park, Blacktown, and is Western Sydney's first major zoo. It's a stunning, purpose-built facility where animals live in large, naturalistic habitats.

What you'll see:
- Giraffes and African savannah animals
- Western lowland gorillas
- Hippos and crocodiles
- Australian wildlife including koalas and wombats
- Over 100 species in total

Good to know:
- Located next to Eastern Creek Raceway — easy to find
- Plenty of parking
- Cafe and picnic areas on site
- Great value family tickets available
address: Bungarribee Park, Great Western Highway, Blacktown NSW 2148
